Episodes.Title: Ppang-gwa bokgwon
Episodes.Actors: Lee Jung-jae, Gong Yoo, Yim Si-wan
Episodes.Plot: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

Episodes.Title: Hallowin pati
Episodes.Actors: Lee Jung-jae, Lee Byung-hun, Wi Ha-joon
Episodes.Plot: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.

Episodes.Actors: Lee Jung-jae, Lee Byung-hun, Yim Si-wan
Episodes.Plot: New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance - down to one final vote.

Episodes.Title: Yeoseot Gaeui Dari
Episodes.Actors: Kang Ae-shim, Park Bo-kyung, Lee Byung-hun
Episodes.Plot: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive -- or face collective elimination.

Episodes.Title: Han Pan Deo
Episodes.Actors: Kang Ae-shim, Kim Byeong-cheol, Lee Byung-hun
Episodes.Plot: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

Episodes.Title: O X
Episodes.Actors: Kang Ae-shim, Lee Byung-hun, Gook-hee Chae
Episodes.Plot: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

Episodes.Title: Chinguwa Jeok
Episodes.Actors: Kang Ae-shim, Lee Byung-hun, Gook-hee Chae
Episodes.Plot: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan--but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.
